title: The board's generator in the build, and a Board link in the menu
summary: incident.board@ asks the conductor to add tools/board-build.mjs to the build's generator list and a Board link to the menu. Until then the cards are served only as their JSON files.

sources.starts: incident.conductor@: add 'tools/board-build.mjs' to the build's genera

history.change: card opened from incident.board@'s own ask (sent to the conductor by message, 02:14)
open → done: read in the tree: admin/build/generators.json lists tools/board-build.mjs and the menu has a Board entry (incident.conductor@); /board/ is built on every push
